clue.text: Musician playing in recital's exhausted tonight

explanation.surface: A worn-out instrumentalist is giving a recital this evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exhausted' looks like a description of the tired performer, but it hollows out the word after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A clarinettist is one kind of musician, an example of the broader category.

clue.text: Soup Dragon's beginning to support Chinese food? I'm not sure

explanation.walkthrough: 'Plastic cards' reads as credit cards, but plastic tells you the letters of the second word are scattered through the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchy is lawless disorder, a synonym for chaos.

clue.text: Come between painters mostly touching Venetian frames

a letter of the Greek alphabet
abbreviation for court

clue.text: Corrupting influence weakens when its extremes are commuted

clue.text: On edge of city, conserving unopened diesel fuel

clue.text: Hands developing Hamlet captures the allure of The Mousetrap?

clue.text: Sensational stuff from LAMDA — Romeo snubbed in performance

clue.text: Fumes concentrated with temperature becoming cold
